subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers revive the linked conflicting fork PR or close it and allow a fresh narrow fix for the custom heartbeat prompt regression?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the issue already has linked-pr-open and no-new-fix-pr state, so automation should not create another fix path until maintainers choose what to do with the conflicting linked PR.

options.title: Refresh or replace the linked fix
options.body: Rebase/adopt the linked PR, or close it and allow a narrow replacement that preserves custom prompts while keeping default-prompt path guidance.

options.title: Wait on the linked PR author
options.body: Leave the issue blocked on the external conflicting PR and ask the contributor to refresh it before any new fix is attempted.

options.title: Close as fixed
options.body: This is not supported by current-main or latest-release source, so it would leave the documented regression unresolved.

recommendation.title: Refresh or replace the linked fix
recommendation.body: Rebase/adopt the linked PR, or close it and allow a narrow replacement that preserves custom prompts while keeping default-prompt path guidance.
